name: Wildberries
note: Right-chest sponsor on Dynamo Makhachkala's 2026-27 home shirt (club kit launch, 2026-07-25). Left unrated: RVB is 65% ООО «Вайлдберриз» (wholly owned by Tatyana Kim) and 35% ООО «Стинн» — half of Stinn belongs to Grigory Sadoyan and half is property of the closed fund ЗПИФ «Гало», whose unit-holders cannot be established from open data, so a 17.5% slice of RVB has unidentified owners; a Stinn-into-RVB merger begun in April 2026 leaves the final structure unknown (T-Journal, July 2026). Separately, after Ukrainian drone strikes set fire to Wildberries warehouses in July 2026, eyewitness accounts collected by iStories and Post- and reported by Meduza (2026-07-19) allege evacuation violations by managers as seven workers were killed in Kotovsk and one in Elektrostal; the company denies the allegations and no court or regulator finding is cited.
